text.description_html:
First Impressions 2-3/4 Inch Crystal Door Knob

This large 2-3/4" diameter crystal door knob is the perfect compliment for bold room designs. Made of imported 24% lead crystal with a high quality brass mounting base for long life.

Also available: Larger 4" Crystal Door Knob and matching Crystal Shower Door Knob Set

The large crystal knob has lots of facets that produce a gleaming color array. Packaged with 1/4-20 x 2" screw for easy installation on doors up to 1-3/4" thick. Available in either a bright polished chrome or a satin nickel finish.

Specifications: for First Impressions Crystal Door Knob

  • Knob Diameter: 2-3/4" (70 mm)
  • Mounting Base Diameter: 3/4"
  • Projection: 2-7/8"
  • Glass Hole Diameter: 3/8" - 1/2"
  • Material: 24% Lead Crystal / Solid Brass

This big crystal knob can be used on large drawers, cabinet doors, pantry doors, or anywhere a bold, sparkling crystal knob would compliment your room's design.

*Sold Individually
